hypothesis: A single precise identity-only lock preserves identity at least as well as repeating redundant identity locks when the same reference fixture and target scene are held constant.
baseline_prompt: Identity lock: use Reference 1 only for recognizable facial identity. Preserve the same recognizable identity throughout. Keep the same person in the final image. Do not change identity. Create a new realistic waist-up portrait in a sunlit botanical reading room. Do not import Reference 1 clothing, pose, camera angle, or background. Dress the subject in a charcoal knit jacket over a cream shirt, seated beside a leafy window and turning slightly toward the camera with relaxed hands resting on a closed book. Use soft daylight, natural skin texture, and restrained depth of field.
